prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - 3000+ calorie high-carbohydrate load with hydration strategy

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 3000+ calories with carbohydrates comprising 55-65% of total calories
Includes 4-5 eating occasions with specific hydration guidance integrated throughout the day
Plan is compact and presented in a single-day format with clear meal timing

prompt_inputs.goal: High-intensity CrossFit training with muscle maintenance

Caloric intake supports intense training (approximately 2800-3200 calories for athlete profile)

prompt_inputs.goal: Muscle gain and strength improvement for weightlifting competition

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all 3 meals plus pre/post-workout nutrition with timing specified
